notes.title: Bomb Escape Update
notes.content:
New languages available:
- English
- Portuguese
- Spanish
- French

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40170237/a439e5363bbe59da92218a914e9cb47805123e5a.png[/img]







More players in a single match:
It is now possible to play with 4 players in a local game, cooperating and earning more points.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40170237/6d9628abe4f35eccb447162e50ca7b4cbba7fb22.png[/img]







New in-game skins:
Try to unlock all players and become a Game Master in Bomb Escape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40170237/5393c2e291a3010c9e65e0d15a2d2b5dd82d2ecb.png[/img]









Now machines, lasers and plasma balls are trying to kill the player!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40170237/fe414b623019bda9e4fd5a755dc81c15de7e977f.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40170237/bad6762babe38b3a4089054ef160ab7b6bae3c98.png[/img]






Try to survive all enemies and reach other planets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40170237/8f2b6e604d02be84cd808d46f8ba88a0665a7618.png[/img]
